data.name: Nikodemus
data.long_meaning: Means 'new life' or 'reborn' in Hebrew. In the Bible, Nicodemus was a Pharisee and a secret disciple of Jesus, who advocated for his release after the crucifixion.

in_hebrew.name: ניקודמוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ניקודמוס הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו איש המועצה היהודית, והוא נזכר בברית החדשה כאחד מתלמידי ישו, היה חבר בסנהדרין והאמין בישו לאחר שפגש אותו

in_greek.name: Νικόδημος
in_greek.long_meaning: Νικόδημος είναι ελληνικό όνομα που σημαίνει νίκη τοῦ δήμου, και αναφέρεται στο Νικόδημο, έναν από τους μαθητές του Ιησού, που ήταν μέλος της συνεδρίου και πίστεψε στον Ιησού μετά την συνάντησή του

in_latin.name: Nicodemus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nicodemus est nomen Latinum quod significat victoria populi, et refertur ad Nicodemum, unum ex discipulis Iesu, qui fuit membrum synedrii et credidit in Iesum postquam eum convenit

in_english.name: Nikodemus
in_english.long_meaning: Nikodemus is a name derived from Greek roots, meaning victory of the people, and refers to Nicodemus, one of Jesus' disciples, who was a member of the Sanhedrin and believed in Jesus after meeting him

biblical_reference.note: Nicodemus is mentioned in the Gospel of John as a Pharisee and a member of the Sanhedrin who believed in Jesus

saint_reference.note: Saint Nicodemus is venerated as a saint in the Eastern Orthodox Church and is commemorated on August 2

data.cultural_impact: Nicodemus is a common name among Christians, particularly in the Greek Orthodox Church. It is derived from the Hebrew name "Nikodemos," which means "victory of the people" or "renewal." In the Bible, Nicodemus is known for his involvement in the ministries of both John the Baptist and Jesus Christ. His actions, such as advocating for Jesus during the Sanhedrin trial, symbolize the role of secret disciples in early Christianity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nicodemus signifies new life and rebirth, a connection to the spiritual journey and transformation found in Christianity. The biblical story of Nicodemus emphasizes the importance of seeking knowledge and understanding, as he went to Jesus in the dead of night to inquire about the teachings of the gospel. This quest for spiritual growth indicates the ongoing desire to deepen one's faith and commitment to God.

historical_references.reference: Nikodemus is a name mentioned in the New Testament, specifically in the Gospel of John, as a Pharisee who comes to Jesus at night to question Him.

trends: used as a given name in various Christian denominations
platforms: Christian baby name websites, religious texts
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Nikodemus remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Hannah Nikodemus from Jerusalem, Israel embodies the meaning of Nikodemus - "New life, reborn". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Nikodemus: Greek name meaning 'victory of the people'; in the Bible, he was a Pharisee who secretly became a disciple of Jesus, symbolizing the transformation of the old self into the new through spiritual rebirth.
